subject: Pay-to-Park Kiosk Program
overview: The Medford City Council voted to request the removal of pay-to-park kiosks, the termination of the city's contract with Republic Parking, and the cancellation of all Patriot's Day parking citations. The Council also revised the 2015 municipal election calendar and acted on resolutions concerning short-term lodging regulations, cable ascertainment hearings, and public meeting video access.

items.title: Airbnb and Short-Term Lodging Ordinance
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting that the city explore zoning and legal mechanisms to regulate short-term lodging services like Airbnb and capture associated revenue.

items.title: Malden Hospital Redevelopment Update
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting an update from city officials regarding redevelopment proposals and discussions concerning the Malden Hospital site.

items.title: Pay-to-Park Kiosk Program and Republic Parking Contract
items.summary: The Council passed resolutions urging the mayor to remove pay-to-park kiosks, terminate the city's contract with Republic Parking forthwith, and void all parking tickets issued on Patriot's Day.

items.title: Congratulating Superintendent Roy Belson
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution congratulating Superintendent Roy Belson on his appointment to the Board of Directors of the Massachusetts Financial Literacy Trust Fund.

items.title: Online City Council Meetings and Volunteerism
items.summary: The Council passed a resolution requesting that the city administration coordinate volunteer assistance to make recordings of public meetings available on the city website.

items.title: Cable Ascertainment Hearing Time Change
items.summary: The Council voted to request that the upcoming cable ascertainment hearing regarding Comcast be moved from 2:00 PM to 6:30 PM.

items.title: Environmentally Friendly Golf Carts Status Update
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting an update from the mayor's office on environmentally friendly golf carts stored at City Hall.

items.title: Utility Street Repair Inspections and DPW Updates
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution requesting that the DPW Director inspect utility street repairs, provide city repair standards, and update the status of the vacant DPW Commissioner position.

items.title: Condolence for Bob Delfino
items.summary: The Council dedicated the meeting and held a moment of silence in memory of former assessor Bob Delfino following his passing.

items.title: 2015 Municipal Election Calendar Revision
items.summary: The Council approved revisions to the 2015 municipal election calendar to address scheduling conflicts with religious holidays.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the records of the previous meeting.
